data.one_liner: Android platform implementation of stripe_platform_interface for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android native bridge and platform implementation for the flutter_stripe plugin ecosystem. It connects the Stripe Android SDK to Flutter to handle payment sheets, Google Pay, and payment intents. Most developers consume this package indirectly via flutter_stripe.
use_when: You are building a custom Stripe platform implementation or overriding the endorsed Android implementation in a Flutter app
You are using flutter_stripe, which automatically includes this package under the hood for Android support
avoid_when: You are developing a standard Flutter app and should depend on flutter_stripe directly instead
You are targeting iOS or Web exclusively without needing Android support
strengths: Officially endorsed Android platform implementation for flutter_stripe
Regularly synced with native Stripe SDKs and Stripe React Native upstream updates
Supports modern Android features like Embedded Payment Element and Google Pay
weaknesses: Not intended to be used directly by end applications (flutter_stripe should be used instead)
Strict dependency requirements, such as needing Flutter 3.47.0 or higher in version 15.0.0
data.setup_notes: Automatically bundled when depending on flutter_stripe; direct usage typically requires no manual configuration beyond flutter_stripe Android setup.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the primary user-facing plugin that wraps this package along with iOS and Web support.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use Adyen instead of Stripe as your payment processor.
